_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9171vgqqqLwGXb1ijPmb3ta)_

Part of #34632

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:让「pm-dispatch 验证」能被召唤并开工。席位词里加「验证 = qa + eval 一席」;QA 章程改为三种信号下自己开轮;评测章程改为问数基线每天一轮、从云端对固定托管测试环境跑。
- **为什么**:#34632 卡上您的裁决「全部 A，D4 加每日上限」(录为评论 6943105103):D2 A(验证席三信号自启)、D3 按更正 6938570276(每天一次、托管测试环境)、D6 A(QA 与评测合为一席，两份章程)。您 09:14Z 召唤验证席时技能不认这个词，所以这块先单独出。
- **范围**:只改三个文件，行数都不变(59、29、45),不抬上限。D1、D4、D7、R1 等其余文字在另一个 PR(同卡切片 R)。
- **风险与回滚**:只改规则文字；验证席仍不写代码、不开 PR。回滚即 revert。
- **需要你做的**:门读 Tier S(`.claude/**` ×3,`check-governed-merges --pr 34745`);席位按 Tier H 处理(自动模式不允许席位自翻受管 PR),L1 ACCEPT 与达档契约审 PASS 在同一 head 后，请您用 os-zhuang 批准，席位随后落地。

## What changes

Ruling of record: `Ruled:` 6943105103 on #34632 (the maintainer's choice 「全部 A，D4 加每日上限」, 2026-11-17), D2 A, D3 as corrected in 6938570276, D6 A.

- `references/project-forms.md` (59 → 59): the seat-word line now maps 验证 to `qa` + `eval` as one seat, so `pm-dispatch 验证` resolves. The example list drops `server` and `objectstack` to fit the 120-byte cap; the rule (every `lanes/` file name is a seat word) is unchanged.
- `references/lanes/qa.md` (29 → 29), D2 and D6:
  - the title names the merged verification seat (one seat, two charters);
  - the seat starts a round itself on three signals: a new release tag (smoke), every child of an un-paused epic closed (milestone acceptance), and a weekly routine round. 「⛔ 本席不自启、不建定时任务」 is gone;
  - the maintainer can still call a round; a release is still read only from the new tag-family reading, never from word of mouth or a branch name.
- `references/lanes/eval.md` (45 → 45), D3 corrected and D6:
  - the title names the merged verification seat;
  - cadence: a scenario-card round weekly, the 问数 baseline daily (was once per release, 「不做每晚回归」 is gone);
  - the baseline runs from the cloud against a fixed hosted test environment (was a local objectos-ee); 56 questions × 5 a round; the gateway key stays in that environment and the runner carries only persona credentials as environment secrets; the first week's real spend goes to the maintainer before any increase;
  - the hand-off line no longer has the seat run the first baseline locally.

## Acceptance notes

- **Line budget:** every file stays at its ceiling (59, 29, 45), headroom 0; widest new line 119 bytes. No ratchet row moves.
- **"未暂停专题"** in `qa.md` means an open `pm:epic` without `pm:on-hold` (R3 on the card). Its definition in the grading text lands with slice R (`lanes/triage.md`, `filing-gate.md`); there was no byte room to define it again here.
- **Readers checked:** `checklist-test` SKILL.md defers "when a round opens" to `lanes/qa.md` (its §6 pointer), so it needs no change. `lanes/skills.md:29` still says QA waves never self-start; slice R points it at `qa.md` (claim amendment 6943981717).
- **Not in this slice:** D1, D4, D5, D7, D8, D9 and the rest of the card's list (slice R, or the triage seat's and the maintainer's own actions).

## Tests

None: rule text only, no tested behaviour.
